comment: Stand-ins for files no source client ships. 'sprites' keys/values are data-relative paths without extension and alias both .spr and .act; 'files' alias one exact file. Upstream's TemporaryMonsterAliases are applied automatically. Put real replacements in the Custom source folder instead of aliasing when you have them.

sprite/몬스터/verit.why: No client ships a verit sprite, the 2009 ones included; kRO keeps Verit's art as mutant_verit, pixel-identical to the Verit in Doddler's June 2025 release

sprite/몬스터/fungus.why: Rebuild custom monster (DoddlerCustomMonsters); closest Plant/Poison mushroom

sprite/인간족/몸통/남/무희바지_여.why: Dancer is female-only; playerclass points the male slot at the female body

sprite/인간족/몸통/여/바드_남.why: Bard is male-only; playerclass points the female slot at the male body

waived.bgm/ToS-3rdWave.flac: Rebuild's Okolnir track (que_qsch01), '3rd Wave' by Questrosound from the Tree of Savior soundtrack; it is not part of any client. Drop it into the Custom folder as bgm/ToS-3rdWave.flac; until then that map plays no music. The fork's copy is the clip from Doddler's June 2025 release (music_assets_assets/music/tos-3rdwave.flac.bundle, exported with UnityPy and saved as FLAC with ffmpeg). An MP3 of the track also works: ffmpeg -i <file>.mp3 -map 0:a ToS-3rdWave.flac.
waived.sprite/방패/*/*_메모라이즈북.spr: Books worn in the shield slot (Memory Book, Exorcism Bible, Magic Bible) have no equipped sprite in any client, the 2009 ones included; the character shows no shield, exactly as in kRO.

wav/inspiration.wav.why: potion effect sound missing from all clients; nearest named sound

texture/effect/hl_blind.tga.why: Blind status icon; kRO only ships the Deep Blind icon now

wav/spore_move.wav.why: move sound event of the spore/deathspore/fungus ACTs; clients only ship spore_move1/2
